brief:
Families in Gaza's Shati refugee camp are enduring winter conditions in deteriorating tents, the Ma'an news agency reported. The camp residents confront inadequate shelter as temperatures drop, compounding existing humanitarian hardships in the enclave.

Aid organizations warn of potential disaster as vulnerable populations—including children and elderly residents—lack proper protection from harsh weather. Overcrowded conditions and scarce resources have intensified concerns over disease and health risks during the winter months.
title: Families in Shati refugee camp face winter in tattered tents
